reviews.title: Worked nicely until it didn’t….
reviews.text: When I first got the app, it was running perfectly, and my videos were with sound. I don’t know if this is something you have to pay for, but after making a few videos, I was distraught to see that the 18 minute video I had worked so hard to create came out with no audio. The videos following also came out with no audio. You might say this is my fault, however after reviewing these said videos, it was shown that the microphone was supposedly on. Why would you make it so the mic says it’s on, but it really isn’t? If I was supposed to pay for the audio, why wouldn’t you make that clear when I first opened the app? Im highly disappointed and i hope this review helps someone think twice before downloading this app.
